hyperedges.label: Primary Design Theme
hyperedges.description: Cohesive primary color (#81263A burgundy) used across all interactive elements and branding. Maintains visual consistency across card CTAs, navbar, and social assets

hyperedges.label: Dark Mode Implementation
hyperedges.description: Comprehensive dark mode support using Tailwind dark: variant. Shared localStorage key 'color-theme' with admin panel. All components support light/dark automatically

hyperedges.label: 3D Card Interactive System
hyperedges.description: Complete 3D perspective card system with mouse-tracking transforms. Uses Context API for state sharing. CardItem components respond to container mouse events with 3D animation

hyperedges.label: Navigation and Routing
hyperedges.description: Responsive navigation with smooth scroll-to-section functionality. Hash-based routing to five main sections plus blogs page. Mobile hamburger menu with full-screen overlay. Page titles sync with routing

hyperedges.label: Typography Scale and Families
hyperedges.description: Multi-family typography: Nunito (body/UI), Poppins (alternative), Georgia (OG headlines), Helvetica (OG CTA). Distinct font sizing for hierarchy. Letter-spacing on CTAs for emphasis

hyperedges.label: Form Components and Inputs
hyperedges.description: Complete form system: Button variants (5 types), input validation with focus rings, custom file input with styled button, checkbox styling. All forms support dark mode and maintain consistent spacing

hyperedges.label: Image and Visual Assets
hyperedges.description: Optimized image handling: Explicit dimensions prevent layout shift. SVG OG image with decorative effects. Fallback mechanisms for broken images. Responsive sizing with object-cover

hyperedges.label: Responsive Design Pattern
hyperedges.description: Mobile-first responsive design using Tailwind breakpoints. lg: breakpoint at 1024px triggers layout changes. Mobile menu closes automatically on resize. Admin panel adjusts padding for desktop

hyperedges.label: Light Theme System
hyperedges.description: Complete light theme visual system using white text, light backgrounds, and primary brand colors.

hyperedges.label: Dark Theme System
hyperedges.description: Complete dark theme visual system using dark text, white brand elements, and primary accent colors.

hyperedges.label: UI Icon Set
hyperedges.description: Cohesive set of interface icons using consistent sizing (18-22px), neutral color palette (#64748B, #757693), and flat geometric design.

hyperedges.label: Brand Integration Icons
hyperedges.description: Set of 48x48px brand/social integration icons with light circular backgrounds (#EEF0F2) for OAuth and third-party service connections.

hyperedges.label: Country/Region Assets
hyperedges.description: Set of 21x14px country flag graphics for localization and region selection UI components.

hyperedges.label: Brand Identity System
hyperedges.description: Complete brand identity system with horizontal and icon-only logos, theme variants, primary color (#3C50E0), and consistent geometric design language.

nodes.label: Blog API - Laravel 11
nodes.description: Laravel 11 backend blogging platform with RESTful API for posts, categories, comments, and user interactions

nodes.label: User Authentication
nodes.description: Secure login and registration using JWT tokens

nodes.label: Post Management
nodes.description: Create, update, and delete blog posts

nodes.label: Category Management
nodes.description: Organize posts into categories

nodes.label: Comments System
nodes.description: Allow users to comment on posts for community engagement

nodes.label: Search Functionality
nodes.description: Find posts quickly with integrated search

nodes.label: Pagination
nodes.description: Efficiently handle large data sets with built-in pagination

nodes.label: CORS Support
nodes.description: Easily integrate with frontend applications

nodes.label: OG Default Image
nodes.description: Open Graph default image with dark gradient background (1200x630px). Linear gradient from #1C2434 to #81263A (deep burgundy). Contains grid pattern with white opacity 0.05, radial glow effect, decorative circles with transparency. Typography: Georgia serif for headline 'Artikel', secondary text 'tanpa gambar' (without image) in lighter opacity. Call-to-action text 'BACA SELENGKAPNYA →' in Helvetica. Accent bar in #81263A at top. Used as fallback thumbnail for articles without custom images.

nodes.label: App Root Styles
nodes.description: Global CSS for root element and fixed positioning of background and navigation

nodes.label: Prose Revert Style
nodes.description: Reverts Tailwind Preflight styles on prose wrapper to restore browser defaults for semantic HTML (h1-h6, p, ul, ol, li, a, blockquote). Restores list styling (disc/decimal) with 2rem margin for visibility

nodes.label: Card3D
nodes.description: Interactive 3D card component for displaying blog articles with 3D perspective transform on mouse movement. Displays article thumbnail, title, category, excerpt (max 200 chars), and 'Read More' button. Responsive with shadow effects on hover. Dark mode support via Tailwind classes. Fallback to DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL (/og-default.svg) on image load error

nodes.label: DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL
nodes.description: Constant export: DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL = '/og-default.svg'. Used as fallback image when article image_url fails to load

nodes.label: Card3D Props
nodes.description: Props: title (string), content (optional string), category (any), image_url (string), slug (string). Used by Card3D component to render article preview

nodes.label: CardContainer
nodes.description: Provides 3D perspective container with mouse tracking. Calculates 3D rotation based on mouse position relative to container center. Uses MouseEnterContext to share mouse state with child CardItem components. Accepts children, className, and containerClassName props

nodes.label: CardBody
nodes.description: Card body wrapper with preserve-3d CSS transform. Fixed h-96 w-96 dimensions. Applies preserve-3d style to all child elements for consistent 3D transformation

nodes.label: CardItem
nodes.description: Individual 3D transformable element within card. Supports 3D transforms: translateX, translateY, translateZ, rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ. Animates on mouse enter/leave via context. Default element is div, customizable via 'as' prop. Smooth 200ms transition duration

nodes.label: useMouseEnter Hook
nodes.description: Custom hook to access MouseEnterContext. Returns [isMouseEntered, setIsMouseEntered] state. Throws error if used outside CardContainer

nodes.label: StickyNavbar
nodes.description: Fixed top navigation bar with smooth scrolling to sections and theme toggle. Responsive mobile menu with hamburger icon. Uses Redux for activeMenu state (landing.activeMenu). Supports hash-based section scrolling (home, work-experience, tech-stack, projects, get-in-touch, blogs). Dark mode toggle persists to localStorage via useColorMode hook

nodes.label: Navigation Sections
nodes.description: Navigation sections: Home, Work Experience, Tech Stack, Projects, Get in touch, Blogs. Each section has Link routing, active state styling, and smooth scroll handler

nodes.label: Brand Logo
nodes.description: Inline SVG logo with arrow design (path arrows) in color #81263A (burgundy). Text 'IVD' as brand identifier. Links to home route

nodes.label: Theme Toggle Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon toggle for light/dark mode. Moon icon (dark mode) and sun icon (light mode) swap visibility based on isDark state. Executes setColorMode('dark'/'light') on click

nodes.label: Mobile Menu
nodes.description: Full-screen mobile navigation overlay with animated fade-in effect (animate-fade-in-down). Shows on small screens (lg:hidden). Hamburger toggle closes on navigation or manual close button. Centered vertical menu layout

nodes.label: Google Fonts Import
nodes.description: Imports Nunito (200-1000 weight, italic variants) and Poppins (100-900 weight, italic variants) from Google Fonts with display=swap

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS Setup
nodes.description: Imports Tailwind base, components, and utilities layers

nodes.label: Admin Panel Component Classes
nodes.description: Tailwind component layer utilities: .admin-panel (card styling with dark mode), .admin-panel-header (border-b with padding), .admin-panel-title (semibold text), .admin-form (grid gap layout), .admin-label (form label styling), .admin-input (text input with focus ring), .admin-file-input (file upload with custom file button), .admin-actions (flex row with border), .admin-preview-image (max-h-56 rounded image)

nodes.label: No Scrollbar Utility
nodes.description: Cross-browser scrollbar hiding: -webkit-scrollbar none (Chrome/Safari/Opera), -ms-overflow-style none (IE/Edge), scrollbar-width none (Firefox)

nodes.label: Chat Height Utility
nodes.description: Dynamic height calculation for chat interface: h-[calc(100vh_-_8.125rem)] mobile, h-[calc(100vh_-_5.625rem)] on lg breakpoint

nodes.label: Button
nodes.description: Polymorphic button component with TypeScript forwardRef. Variants: default (primary bg), secondary (slate), outline (border), ghost (text-only), destructive (danger red). Sizes: default (h-10 px-4), sm (h-9 px-3), icon (h-10 w-10). Includes focus ring, disabled states, and dark mode support

nodes.label: Button Variant: Default
nodes.description: Primary button variant: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 focus-visible:ring-primary

nodes.label: Button Variant: Secondary
nodes.description: Secondary button: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 with dark mode (bg-slate-800 text-slate-100)

nodes.label: Button Variant: Outline
nodes.description: Outline button: border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-900 with dark mode (border-slate-800 bg-slate-950)

nodes.label: Button Variant: Ghost
nodes.description: Ghost button (text-only): text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 with dark mode (text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-900)

nodes.label: Button Variant: Destructive
nodes.description: Destructive (danger) button: bg-danger text-white hover:bg-danger/90 focus-visible:ring-danger

nodes.label: Card
nodes.description: Base card container component with shadow and rounded border. Supports dark mode styling (dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-950). Forwardable ref and class merging via cn() utility

nodes.label: CardHeader
nodes.description: Card section for header content. Flex column layout with gap-1.5 padding (p-4 mobile, sm:p-6 desktop)

nodes.label: CardTitle
nodes.description: Card section h3 heading element. Text base font-semibold leading-none

nodes.label: CardDescription
nodes.description: Card section p paragraph element for description text. text-sm text-slate-500 with dark mode (dark:text-slate-400)

nodes.label: CardContent
nodes.description: Card section for main content. Padding p-4 pt-0 mobile (sm:p-6 sm:pt-0 desktop)

nodes.label: PageTitle
nodes.description: Utility component that sets document.title on mount/route change. Updates document title reactively. Renders null (no DOM output). Used for page SEO and browser tab titles

nodes.label: PageTitle Props
nodes.description: Props: title (string). Single prop for document title text

nodes.label: Node.js 18+
nodes.description: Node.js and npm required for frontend assets and build tooling

nodes.label: PHP 8.1+
nodes.description: PHP version 8.1 or higher required

nodes.label: Composer
nodes.description: PHP dependency manager required for Laravel

nodes.label: MySQL or PostgreSQL
nodes.description: Relational database for blog data storage

nodes.label: React
nodes.description: React library used for frontend components (React.forwardRef, React.FC patterns)

nodes.label: React Router
nodes.description: Used for client-side routing (Link component from react-router-dom)

nodes.label: Redux
nodes.description: Redux for state management (useSelector, useDispatch, landing.activeMenu slice)

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS
nodes.description: Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling throughout components

nodes.label: TypeScript
nodes.description: TypeScript for type safety in React components (.tsx files)

nodes.label: Primary Color
nodes.description: Primary brand color (bg-primary). Used in Button, StickyNavbar, OG image. Tailwind custom color (likely #81263A burgundy based on SVG and OG image)

nodes.label: Danger Color
nodes.description: Danger/destructive color for warning/delete actions. Tailwind danger class

nodes.label: Dark Mode Palette
nodes.description: Dark mode color scheme: dark:bg-slate-950, dark:text-slate-50, dark:border-slate-800. Consistent slate palette for dark backgrounds. Applied via dark: Tailwind variant

nodes.label: Large Breakpoint
nodes.description: Tailwind lg: breakpoint for responsive design. Used to hide/show mobile menu and adjust layout for desktop

nodes.label: OG Primary Gradient
nodes.description: Linear gradient background for OG image: #1C2434 (dark navy) to #81263A (burgundy). Angle: 0 to 1200x630 pixels. Creates depth from cool to warm tones

nodes.label: OG Glow Radial Gradient
nodes.description: Radial gradient glow effect centered at (940, 130) with scale 460. Color #81263A with opacity fade from 0.75 to 0. Creates burgundy glow effect in top-right corner

nodes.label: OG Grid Pattern
nodes.description: Repeating grid pattern at 48x48 pixel intervals. White stroke with 0.05 opacity for subtle texture overlay. Creates subtle grid structure

nodes.label: OG Decorative Circles
nodes.description: Two concentric circles at (940, 130): radius 210 and 320. White stroke with 0.08 and 0.05 opacity respectively. Create minimalist decorative rings in top-right glow area

nodes.label: OG Accent Bar
nodes.description: Horizontal accent bar (86x6px, rx=3 border-radius) in #81263A color at top of text area. Visual hierarchy element

nodes.label: OG Headline Typography
nodes.description: Georgia serif font, 76px, weight 700, white color. Text: 'Artikel' (Article). Large scale for primary headline

nodes.label: OG Secondary Typography
nodes.description: Georgia serif font, 76px, weight 700, white with 0.55 opacity. Text: 'tanpa gambar' (without image). Secondary headline with reduced emphasis

nodes.label: OG CTA Typography
nodes.description: Helvetica/Arial sans-serif, 24px, letter-spacing 4px, white with 0.45 opacity. Text: 'BACA SELENGKAPNYA →' (READ MORE →). Call-to-action with increased letter spacing for emphasis

nodes.label: Card3D Read More Button
nodes.description: Read More button with arrow icon (→). Link to /blogs/:slug. Styling: bg-black dark:bg-white hover:bg-primary dark:hover:bg-primary. Switches to primary color on hover. Text-xs font-bold

nodes.label: Card3D Image Container
nodes.description: Image element with h-60 w-full object-cover rounded-xl. 3D transform translateZ=100. Shadow on hover (group-hover/card:shadow-xl). Explicit width/height 1000x1000 for optimization

nodes.label: Card3D Category Badge
nodes.description: Category display with 3D transform translateZ=50. Font bold, text-md, rounded-xl. Dark mode support (dark:text-white)

nodes.label: Card3D Content Excerpt
nodes.description: Optional content excerpt with 3D transform translateZ=60. Text-neutral-500 text-sm max-w-sm. Content truncated to 200 chars with '...' suffix. Rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML (HTML content support)

nodes.label: Card3D Container Styling
nodes.description: CardBody styling: bg-gray-50 dark:bg-dark (custom dark color). Border: border-2 border-bodydark2 dark:border-gray-dark dark:border-2. Rounded xl, p-6. Hover shadows: dark:hover:shadow-2xl dark:hover:shadow-emerald-500/[0.1]

nodes.label: MouseEnterContext
nodes.description: Context API pattern for sharing mouse enter state between CardContainer and CardItem components. Type: [boolean, Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>]

nodes.label: 3D Transform Calculation
nodes.description: Mouse position transform calculation: rotateY based on (e.clientX - left - width/2)/25, rotateX based on (e.clientY - top - height/2)/25. Divider of 25 controls rotation sensitivity. Inverse relationship: move mouse right → negative rotateY

nodes.label: useColorMode Hook
nodes.description: Custom hook for theme management. Shares 'color-theme' localStorage key with admin switcher and pre-paint script. Returns [colorMode, setColorMode]. Values: 'light' | 'dark'. Applies html.dark class for dark mode

nodes.label: Navbar Responsive Behavior
nodes.description: Window resize listener closes mobile menu when window.innerWidth >= 960px (lg breakpoint). Enables responsive menu auto-collapse on desktop resize

nodes.label: Form Validation
nodes.description: Admin form input validation styling: focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20. Clear focus states for accessibility. Disabled state: cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-100 text-slate-500

nodes.label: File Upload Styling
nodes.description: Custom file input styling with custom file button: bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2.5 border-r border-slate-200. Hover effect: file:hover:bg-slate-200. Dark mode support: dark:file:bg-slate-900 dark:file:border-slate-800

nodes.label: Table Checkbox Styling
nodes.description: Custom checkbox styling for tables: .tableCheckbox:checked state applies opacity-100 to span child and bg-primary border-primary to parent div

nodes.label: Color Contrast
nodes.description: Primary button uses white text on primary (burgundy) background. OG image uses white text on dark gradient. Sufficient contrast for WCAG AA compliance

nodes.label: Image Optimization
nodes.description: Explicit width/height (1000x1000) prevents layout shift. object-cover maintains aspect ratio. Fallback mechanism for load errors. Responsive sizing with max-width constraints

nodes.label: Arrow Down Icon
nodes.description: 18x18px downward-pointing arrow icon. Solid stroke design with fill color #64748B (slate gray). Used for dropdown triggers and menu expansion. Clean geometric path suitable for navigation UI.

nodes.label: Sun Icon
nodes.description: 22x22px sun icon with radiating lines. Fill color #757693 (muted slate). Represents light mode toggle in theme switching UI. Circular sun with 8 rays, used for light theme activation.

nodes.label: Moon Icon
nodes.description: 21x21px crescent moon icon. Fill color #757693 (muted slate). Represents dark mode toggle in theme switching. Curved crescent design paired with sun icon for theme control.

nodes.label: Calendar Icon
nodes.description: 18x18px calendar/date picker icon. Fill color #64748B (slate gray). Grid-based calendar representation with date cells. Used for date input fields and calendar triggers.

nodes.label: Copy Icon (Alt)
nodes.description: 20x20px document copy icon. White fill (fill='#FFFFFF' with class='fill-current'). Dual document layers indicating copy operation. Used for copy-to-clipboard actions.

nodes.label: Logo Full (Light Theme)
nodes.description: 176x32px full horizontal logo with text. Components: (1) Blue square brand icon (#3C50E0) with 3 white bars of varying opacity (opacity: 1, 0.9, 0.7) representing a bar chart or audio waveform. (2) 'Blog' text in white font. Drop shadow effects (0.5px blur, 12% opacity). Suitable for light backgrounds.

nodes.label: Logo Full (Dark Theme)
nodes.description: 176x32px full horizontal logo with text. Same layout as light version but text color changed to #1C2434 (dark blue-gray) instead of white. Blue brand icon (#3C50E0) with white bars remains identical. For dark backgrounds or dark mode display.

nodes.label: Logo Icon (Square)
nodes.description: 32x32px square logo icon. Blue background (#3C50E0) with rounded corners. Contains 3 white vertical bars of descending opacity (1, 0.9, 0.7) representing growth chart or audio waveform pattern. Drop shadow effects applied. Suitable for favicon, app icon, or profile pictures.

nodes.label: Google Brand Icon
nodes.description: 48x48px Google logo. Light gray circular background (#EEF0F2). Contains official Google colors: blue (#4285F4), red (#EB4335), yellow (#FBBC05), green (#34A853). Used for OAuth login buttons and social media integration.

nodes.label: Brand Icon 02
nodes.description: 48x48px brand integration icon. Light circular background. Specific branding asset for social or third-party service integration.

nodes.label: Brand Icon 03
nodes.description: 48x48px brand integration icon. Part of brand icon set for various service integrations.

nodes.label: Brand Icon 04
nodes.description: 48x48px brand integration icon. Consistent sizing with other brand icons.

nodes.label: Brand Icon 05
nodes.description: 48x48px brand integration icon. Final icon in brand icon set.

nodes.label: Country Flag 01 (US)
nodes.description: 21x14px country flag. Horizontal striped pattern with red (#D02F44) and white bands. Blue canton in upper-left with star pattern. US flag design. Used for language/region selection, country picker UI.

nodes.label: Country Flag 02
nodes.description: 21x14px country flag graphic. Part of flag set for country/locale selection.

nodes.label: Country Flag 03
nodes.description: 21x14px country flag graphic.

nodes.label: Country Flag 04
nodes.description: 21x14px country flag graphic.

nodes.label: Country Flag 05
nodes.description: 21x14px country flag graphic.

nodes.label: Country Flag 06
nodes.description: 21x14px country flag graphic.

nodes.label: Favicon ICO
nodes.description: Browser favicon file (ICO format). Used in browser tab display, bookmarks, and address bar.

nodes.label: Primary Color Palette
nodes.description: Primary brand color: #3C50E0 (indigo blue). Used prominently in logo, brand elements, and primary UI actions.

nodes.label: Neutral Color Palette
nodes.description: Primary neutral colors: #64748B (slate gray) for standard icons, #757693 (muted slate) for theme icons. Used for secondary UI elements and icons.

nodes.label: Dark Text Color
nodes.description: Dark mode text color: #1C2434 (dark blue-gray). Used for text and branding in dark theme contexts.

nodes.label: Light Text Color
nodes.description: Light mode text color: white or #FFFFFF. Used for text and branding in light theme contexts and over dark backgrounds.

nodes.label: Background Color
nodes.description: Light background/surface color: #EEF0F2 (very light gray). Used for circular backgrounds in brand icons and surfaces.

nodes.label: Google OAuth Colors
nodes.description: Google brand colors: Blue #4285F4, Red #EB4335, Yellow #FBBC05, Green #34A853. Used for OAuth/social login integration.

nodes.label: Subtle Drop Shadow
nodes.description: Subtle drop shadow effect: offset 0.5px, blur 0.5px, opacity 12%. Applied to logo elements for minimal depth. Used consistently across brand assets.

nodes.label: Filter-based Shadow
nodes.description: Filter-based drop shadow: feOffset dy='1', feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='2', opacity 6%. Applied to decorative elements like flag stars for subtle depth.

nodes.label: Small Icon Size
nodes.description: Small icon dimensions: 18x18px (most icons) to 22x22px. Used for inline icons in forms, navigation, and UI controls.

nodes.label: Medium Icon Size
nodes.description: Medium icon dimensions: 48x48px. Used for brand integration icons, OAuth buttons, and social login options.

nodes.label: Large Icon Size
nodes.description: Large icon dimensions: 176x32px (horizontal logo), 32x32px (icon-only logo). Used for main branding, app headers, and primary navigation.

nodes.label: Small Flag Size
nodes.description: Flag dimensions: 21x14px. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2 (standard flag proportion). Used for country/region selection dropdowns.

nodes.label: Responsive ViewBox Design
nodes.description: All SVG icons use viewBox attribute for scalable rendering. No fixed pixel dimensions in markup—sizes defined via width/height CSS or attributes. Allows responsive scaling across different screen sizes.

nodes.label: Flat Icon Style
nodes.description: Icons use flat, solid fill design with no gradients or textures. Simple geometric paths with single fill colors. Clean, minimal aesthetic suitable for UI integration.

nodes.label: Geometric Logo Style
nodes.description: Logo combines geometric shapes (square, vertical bars) with typography. Bar chart/waveform abstraction. Modern, data-driven visual metaphor.

nodes.label: Solid Stroke Style
nodes.description: Icons use solid fills rather than strokes. Paths created with precise SVG geometry for consistent rendering at all scales.
